biotools.summary: Pharmaceutical intelligence platform that connects drugs, clinical trials, results, patents, regulatory approvals, companies and deals into one knowledge graph updated daily from public sources worldwide, including China. Used for competitive intelligence, landscapes for any target, disease or modality, asset due diligence and trial outcome forecasting (PTRS). Every answer and report links back to its sources. Available on the web and in ChatGPT and Claude through an MCP server and API.
